Blue Track Jacket & Alpine Glow
Rights check
Source: 24606.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long black hair and blunt
bangs wears a blue quilted jacket with white side
stripes. She glances over her shoulder toward the
camera, with a soft, neutral expression and a light blush
on her cheeks. Snow-covered alpine peaks and a deep
blue sky fill the background. Bright, clean sunlight, a
palette of cobalt blue, white, and warm skin tones.
Fresh and calm, in the style of an outdoor lifestyle
portrait.
Calm, fresh, clear
WORKING NOTES
- The over-the-shoulder glance adds intimacy; keep it in
the prompt.
- Use 'close-up, head and shoulders' for a tighter crop.
